# Norwich Free Walking Tours

> Daily merit-based (tip-what-it-was-worth) walking tour of Norwich, UK. Led by a local guide. Runs daily, 2 hours, about 2.5 km, starts at The Forum and finishes at Norwich Market.

The Real Norwich Essentials Tour is a free-to-book walking tour of Norwich city centre covering, in order: The Forum, The Guildhall, The Norwich Lanes, St Andrews Hall, Elm Hill, Fye Bridge, Tombland, Norwich Cathedral, London Street (the first pedestrianised street in the UK), Norwich Castle, The Arcade, and Norwich Market, where the tour finishes right in the heart of the city (well placed for lunch). Book a free spot online, meet the guide at The Forum, tip what the tour was worth at the end by card or cash. Guests typically tip £10 to £20 per person.

Founder + guide: Tom Thornhill, a Norwich resident who has lived in the city for over a decade and runs the walks most days. The tour functions, as guests describe it, as "a walking visitor centre with a local."

## Key facts

- Meeting point: The Forum, Norwich (central city, next to the library), Millennium Plain, NR2 1TF
- Duration: about 2 hours
- Distance: about 2.5 km (1.5 miles), mostly flat, no big hikes
- Route: starts at The Forum, finishes at Norwich Market in the city centre
- Schedule: daily, rain or shine; tours typically leave at 10:30am (exact times on the booking calendar)
- Group size: maximum 15 per tour
- Language: English
- Cost: free to book; tip what the tour was worth at the end (guests typically tip £10 to £20 per person)
- Payment methods: card or cash (Apple Pay and Google Pay also accepted)
- Reviews: 5.0 stars on Google (66 reviews), 5.0 stars on TripAdvisor (39 reviews, all 5-star)
- Booking: https://www.norwichfreewalkingtours.co.uk/book
- Contact: hello@norwichfreewalkingtours.co.uk
